plugin.note: Frost dragons have a 100% fire elemental weakness and are dragonbane targets. Protect from Melee plus full dragonfire protection nullifies their damage; full dragonfire protection also prevents icy breath freezing.

requirements: Eternal brazier constructed on a boat, or access to another player's boat with one
85 combat to receive Frost dragon assignments
Nieve/Steve or Duradel/Kuradal assignment for on-task kills
Full dragonfire protection through antifire plus anti-dragon shield, or super antifire potion alone
Fairy ring DLP access requires visiting Grimstone at least once
mechanics: Frost dragons only use melee and short-ranged icy dragonfire.
Their icy dragonfire briefly freezes players who lack adequate protection.
Unlike wyvern icy breath, Frost dragon icy breath is fully negated by normal dragonfire protection.
A regular antifire potion partially reduces icy dragonfire.
A regular antifire potion with an anti-dragon shield, or a super antifire potion alone, fully negates icy dragonfire.
Protect from Melee combined with full dragonfire protection prevents all incoming damage.
Frost dragons can be safespotted because their dragonfire is short-ranged.
They are weakest to crush, then stab, and much more resistant to slash.
They have a 100% elemental weakness to fire spells.
They are dragons, so dragonbane weapons apply.
Being on task increases Dragon metal sheet drop rate from 1/100 to 1/40.

methods.label: Attacks and protection
methods.summary: Nullify Frost dragon damage with Protect from Melee and full dragonfire protection.
steps: Use Protect from Melee when fighting in melee distance.
Maintain full dragonfire protection with antifire plus an anti-dragon shield, or with a super antifire potion alone.
Do not treat the icy breath like wyvern breath; Frost dragon icy breath follows normal dragonfire protection rules.
Use a safespot when ranging or maging to avoid melee and short-ranged dragonfire.
Refresh antifire protection before it expires so icy breath cannot freeze the player.
risks: A regular antifire potion alone only partially reduces icy dragonfire.
Insufficient dragonfire protection can allow freezes and high dragonfire damage.

methods.label: Transportation
methods.summary: Reach Grimstone through Sailing access, then return with DLP or a moored boat route.
recommendedFor: Players who have visited Grimstone once
steps: Unlock Grimstone access with 87 Sailing and an eternal brazier on a boat, or use another player's boat with one.
After visiting Grimstone at least once, use fairy ring DLP for the fastest return route.
Alternatively, use a boat moored at Grimstone with a greater teleport focus.
Sailing from a nearby port such as Weiss is another route when teleport access is unavailable.
Use the task-only cavern west of the main area when killing Frost dragons on assignment.
notes: The monster page says off-task attacks in the task-only area are blocked by a strange coldness permission message.

methods.label: Melee crush dragonbane
methods.summary: Use dragonbane or crush-biased melee; Frost dragons are weakest to crush, then stab.
recommendedFor: Players using Slayer helmet on task
Players using Protect from Melee and full dragonfire protection
steps: Use Dragon hunter lance on crush when available.
Prefer crush weapons such as Inquisitor's mace or Abyssal bludgeon when not using lance.
Use stab alternatives such as Osmumten's fang, Ghrazi rapier, or Zamorakian hasta when crush options are weaker.
Use Slayer helmet on task, with Torva, Inquisitor, Oathplate, Bandos, Blood moon, or Proselyte-style armour based on budget and prayer needs.
Use Burning claws or Dragon claws for special attacks if the shield and potion plan keeps full dragonfire protection active.
Keep Protect from Melee active unless safespotting.
risks: Slash is much worse against Frost dragons than crush or stab.
Dropping below full dragonfire protection can allow icy breath freezes.

methods.label: Ranged heavy dragonbane
methods.summary: Use heavy ranged or dragonbane ranged from a safespot.
steps: Use Dragon hunter crossbow as the primary ranged dragonbane option.
Use Twisted bow, Bow of faerdhinen, or high-tier crossbows when dragonbane ranged is unavailable.
Safespot to avoid melee and short-ranged dragonfire.
Keep dragonfire protection active even when safespotting in case pathing or range changes expose the player.
Use Slayer helmet on task where applicable.
risks: Frost dragons are more resistant to ranged attacks than chromatic dragons.
Leaving the safespot without full dragonfire protection can lead to freezes.

methods.label: Magic fire spells
methods.summary: Use fire spells or dragonbane magic to exploit the 100% fire elemental weakness.
recommendedFor: Players using Tome of fire or fire-support gear
requiredOrKeyItems: Tome of fire with searing pages
steps: Use Magic when the 100% fire elemental weakness makes fire spells efficient for the account.
Use Dragon hunter wand or Harmonised nightmare staff where available.
Use Twinflame staff, Tumeken's shadow, Eye of ayak, Sanguinesti staff, or tridents as fallback magic options.
Use Tome of fire with searing pages for fire-spell setups when shield slot trade-offs are acceptable.
Safespot where possible and maintain dragonfire protection for pathing mistakes.
risks: Some high-damage magic setups use an off-hand that competes with shield-based dragonfire protection.
Powered staff costs can reduce profit compared with melee.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Bring protection, boost potions, task extension supplies, and storage for high-value Frost dragon drops.
inventory: Full dragonfire protection setup: antifire plus anti-dragon shield, or super antifire potion alone
Prayer potions for Protect from Melee and offensive prayers
Combat, Ranged, or Magic boost potion for the selected style
Food for mistakes and travel damage
Runes or ammunition for the selected style
Bracelet of slaughter if extending the task is desired
steps: Prioritise on-task kills when targeting Dragon metal sheets because task status improves the rate from 1/100 to 1/40.
Expect Frost dragon bones every kill and Dragon nails as a notable drop.
Pick up loot from the central north-eastern tile where Frost dragon drops appear.
Use the I see Dragons unlock only when long Frost dragon tasks are desirable.
notes: Frost dragons do not count as blue dragons or metal dragons for other Slayer tasks.
Chance of Heavy Frost increases task weighting from 5 to 8.

styleOptions.label: Melee crush dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Use Dragon hunter lance on crush, or another crush/stab one-handed weapon, with Protect from Melee and dragonfire protection.

styleOptions.label: Ranged heavy dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Use Dragon hunter crossbow or other heavy ranged options from a safespot.

styleOptions.label: Magic fire spells
styleOptions.summary: Use fire spells, dragonbane magic, or high-tier powered staves against the 100% fire weakness.
